evidence.claim: Eigenmann & Veronelli distribuisce e produce specialità chimiche e ingredienti alimentari dal 1910 con stabilimenti a Trecate, Gorla Minore e Tradate.
evidence.quote: EV is a leading player in the distribution , manufacture and marketing of specialty chemicals and food ingredients . Our story began in 1910, thanks to the innovative and forward-looking vision of our founders || The Group has three production plants in Italy, with a total surface area of 75,000 sqm – Trecate (Novara), Gorla Minore and Tradate (Varese) || specialized in nutrition, healthcare, beauty & personal care, coatings & construction, advanced materials and performance solutions
